title: Together Compiler: Continual Compilation for AI Inference
abstract: arXiv:2611.14681v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Today's AI workloads are rapidly changing: new models are released more often, model architectures are increasingly diverse, and traffic distributions change frequently. The challenge we face at Together AI is continual optimization for these changing workloads. Compiling a deployment into an optimized forward pass is a challenge that is well-suited for agent hill-climbing. Existing systems struggle with continual compilation due to a tradeoff between measurement throughput and fidelity. Many systems use agents to optimize individual kernels from the inference forward pass using offline benchmarks, but timings are low-fidelity because of data-dependent behavior in primitives like mixture-of-experts (MoE). On the other hand, systems use agents to directly optimize end-to-end engines but suffer from slow engine launch times. To address these challenges, we build Together Compiler (TKCC), the first truly continual agent loop designed for AI

translated_title: Together 编译器：面向 AI 推理的持续编译
translated_abstract: 当今的 AI 工作负载正在快速变化：新模型的发布更加频繁，模型架构日益多样化，流量分布也经常变化。Together AI 面临的挑战是对这些不断变化的工作负载进行持续优化。将部署编译为优化的前向传播是一项非常适合智能体爬山搜索的任务。现有系统由于在测量吞吐量与保真度之间存在权衡，难以实现持续编译。许多系统使用智能体基于离线基准测试来优化推理前向传播中的单个内核，但由于混合专家（MoE）等原语中存在数据依赖行为，其计时结果保真度较低。另一方面，一些系统使用智能体直接优化端到端引擎，却受制于缓慢的引擎启动时间。为应对这些挑战，我们构建了 Together Compiler（TKCC），这是首个真正面向 AI 设计的持续智能体循环。
tldr: Together Compiler（TKCC）是首个真正面向 AI 推理的持续智能体编译循环，解决了现有系统在测量吞吐量与保真度之间的权衡难题，能够针对快速变化的模型架构与流量分布持续优化推理的前向传播。
en_tdlr: Together Compiler (TKCC) is the first truly continual agent loop for AI inference compilation, resolving the throughput-fidelity tradeoff in existing systems to continuously optimize inference forward passes amid rapidly changing models and traffic.
